props.name: name
props.doc: (Human readable) name of this API

name: ApiNodeGroup
doc: Defines a group of API nodes

props.doc: ID of the API this node group belongs to

props.name: name
props.doc: (Human readable) name of this node group

props.name: description
props.doc: Description of this group's function or theme

name: ApiNode
doc: Represents an individual API node implementation

props.name: groupId
props.doc: ID of the node group this node belongs to

props.name: name
props.doc: Human-readable name of this node

props.name: nameNoSpaces
props.doc: A lowercase version of the node name, with no whitespace included. Used for indexing & search.

props.name: relativePath
props.doc:
Path of this node, relative to the parent node (if defined) or the API root (if no parent is defined). 
May contain path parameters.

props.name: parentId
props.doc:
ID of the node that appears directly above/before this node on the path. 
None if no parent node appears between this node and the API root.

props.name: description
props.doc: A description of this API node.

name: PathParametersSchemaLink
doc: Applies a specific schema to the path parameters received by an API node.

props.name: nodeId
props.doc: ID of the API node that accepts these parameters.

props.name: modelTypeId
props.doc: ID of the model type that describes the received path parameters.

name: ApiNodeMethodImplementation
doc: Describes how a specific HTTP method is implemented in an API node.

props.name: nodeId
props.doc: ID of the API node that contains this implementation.

props.name: method
props.doc: The implemented method.

props.name: description
props.doc: A description of this implementation.

props.name: requiresRequestBody
props.doc: Whether a request body is required for this implementation.

name: ApiNodeMethodImplementationModelSchemaLink
doc: Links a model schema to to an API node's method implementation.

props.name: implementationId
props.doc: ID of the method implementation that uses the linked schema.

props.name: modelTypeId
props.doc: ID of the schema that defines the type of model accepted by the linked implementation.

name: QueryParametersSchemaLink
doc: Applies a specific schema to the query parameters accepted by an API node.

name: RequestBodySchema
doc:
Applies a specific schema to the request body accepted by an API node. 
Multiple alternative schemas may be defined separately.

props.name: customContentType
props.doc: Non-standard content type expected from the request body, if applicable.

props.name: description
props.doc: Description of the expected request body.

props.name: isArray
props.doc: Whether a JSON array is expected.

name: PossibleResponseStatus
doc: Defines a possible response status for an API node method call.

props.name: implementationId
props.doc: ID of the implementation that may return this response status.

props.name: statusCode
props.doc: HTTP status code that may be returned by the API node method call.

props.name: description
props.doc: Description of what this status signifies.

props.name: hasBody
props.doc: Whether a response body is returned with this status. Uncertain if not specified in the documentation.

name: ResponseContentType
doc: Defines how an API node's response body is formed.

props.name: statusId
props.doc: ID of the status this type of response body is returned with.

props.name: contentType
props.doc: If this body is non-empty, specifies the type of content it contains.

props.name: modelTypeId
props.doc: If this body contains a JSON object or objects, contains the ID of the model schema that describes the applicable object structure.

props.name: isArray
props.doc: Whether this response body contains an array of values. False if no more than one value may be returned.

props.name: isEmpty
props.doc: Whether this response body is empty / no response body is returned.

name: NodeAuthLink
doc: Common trait for links between API nodes and possible authorization requirements

props.name: nodeId
props.doc: ID of the node that accepts the linked authorization method.

props.name: authId
props.doc: ID of the authorization element accepted by the linked node.

props.name: method
props.doc:
The HTTP method that the linked authorization method is used for. 
None if the authorization method is used as a default for all methods (where not overridden).

props.name: description
props.doc: A description concerning this authorization method's function in the linked node.

name: NodeAuthTypeLink
doc: Describes an authorization type accepted by an API node.

combo.name: DetailedNodeAuthTypeLink
combo.doc: Includes the authorization type accepted by the linked node.

props.name: authTypeId
props.doc: ID of the authorization type accepted by the linked node.

name: NodeAuthScopeLink
doc:
Describes an authorization scope required by an API node. 
If multiple scopes are linked, they typically represent alternative auth scopes, usually for different purposes.

combo.doc: Includes possible additional scope requirements with a node-scope link

props.name: scopeId
props.doc: ID of the authorization scope required by the linked node.

name: AdditionalNodeAuthScopeRequirement
doc: Links an additional required scope to an auth-scope link

props.name: scopeLinkId
props.doc: ID of the auth-scope link that requires the additional scope
ID of the additional authorization scope required by the node.
